what: Creating parquet directly from zip files
title: Reading CPRD Files Into Parquet Via Arrow
text: can use function read_zipped_dataset_to_parquet can tables (‘patient’, ‘observation’, ‘practice’) dataset. pq_in functions like normal data frame (running collect bring R session computations):
code: library(arrowCPRD)  read_zipped_dataset_to_parquet(   [folder containing zipped cprd aurum files],   write_directory = "parquet_data",   dataset_tag = "patient",   schema = aurum_patient_schemas,   table_name = "patient" )  pq_in <- open_dataset("parquet_data") |>   tibble::as_tibble() library(tidyverse)  pq_in |>    summarise(mean_val = mean(value), .by = "pracid") |>   collect()
